name: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd
title: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd - 544058 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mufti (Credo Brands) is a store-count-flat, throughput-led year: FY27 guided to ~20 openings and ~20 closures, mid-single-digit same-store growth at best, and EBITDA margin seen at 23–24% on higher ad spend.

capex.quote: capex per store is around INR40 lakhs to INR45 lakhs depending on the location and whether it is high street or mall.

triggers.label: Same-store sales flattish in Q4
triggers.quote: The same-store sales growth for the quarter is flattish. For the year, it has been lower, but for the quarter, it's flat.

triggers.label: FY27 margin 23–24% vs 26% FY26
triggers.quote: FY27 may be slightly lower, may be around 23%, 24% because the marketing spend is going to go up in the next year.

triggers.label: Net store closures: 24 closed, 7 opened
triggers.quote: During the quarter, we have opened 7 new stores, and we have closed 24 stores.

triggers.label: Debtor days ~140–146, structurally high
triggers.quote: currently, we are at, say, 140, 146 days.

guidance.value: ~20 openings and ~20 closures; flat store count
guidance.quote: we are looking to close roughly 20 -odd stores during the coming financial year. And we intend to open also roughly similar number of 20-odd stores.

guidance.value: mid-single-digit at best; FY27 flattish per Q&A
guidance.quote: We'll be happy if we see mid-single-digit growth in the coming year.
FY27 may be slightly lower, may be around 23%, 24% because the marketing spend is going to go up in the next year.
advertising and branding investments are expected to increase further to approximately 8% to 10% of revenues.
we expect to remain within the range of 56% to 58%.

red_flags.label: Debtor days ~140–146 and rising
red_flags.quote: currently, we are at, say, 140, 146 days.

red_flags.label: Same-store sales flat, store count shrinking
red_flags.quote: So, this is not the correct year to be looking at growth perspective.

evasions.quote: it's a little early to draw any definitive conclusions because these stores are relatively new

evasions.topic: Input cost and gross margin outlook
evasions.quote: these are very difficult to predict today whether it will be 56% to 58% or it could even go down to 55%
